notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hi people! :)

How are you all?

Recently, someone has brought it to my attention that DOWN MEANS UP won't launch with the (second) latest update.

The issue was a directory having the wrong name.  It's fixed now.

This was probably my bad, but I can't remember coming across anything strange after uploading said update.


Regardless, it's working now, and I thank you for you patience.
Also special thanks to the person that brought it under my attention!


Happy Flipping!

Kind Regards,
David
